$comment: Every path this plugin delivers into a project, and how /workflow-update treats it. A path missing from this file is a bug: the update reports it instead of guessing.

classes.plugin: Manifest-driven mirror: refresh the listed files, delete what a previous manifest listed and this one no longer does, and leave anything else alone. A project extends by ADDING a file here, never by editing a shipped one.
classes.mixed: Replaced, except `project-specific: <id>` marker blocks, which are carried into the new version by id.
classes.project: Never touched after the initial creation.
classes.merge-interactive: Only when the plugin changed this file between the installed and the target version: Claude performs a three-way merge (base = the old plugin version, ours = the project's file, theirs = the new plugin version), always showing the diff and asking before writing.
classes.merge: Merged mechanically by a fixed rule stated on the entry.

entries.note: Only the library files matched at init are installed; a newly shipped one is offered, never forced.
Plugin-owned. A project adds its own hook as a new file — manifest-driven mirroring leaves it alone, and its settings.json entry survives because that merge only ever adds.

entries.merge: Add missing hook entries and permissions.allow members; never remove; add statusLine only if absent; leave every other key.

entries.note: The project's commands and the plugin's scaffolding are interleaved; replacing them would silently produce a gate that exits 0 with nothing to run.
